basic_info.description: Welcome to The Potrero Unit 568! This bright and inviting top floor corner condo offers 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with abundant natural light from its north and west-facing windows in one of San Francisco's sunniest neighborhoods. This smart floor plan features a foyer with closet, open-concept living and dining area, refinished hardwood floors, a spacious ensuite primary bedroom with large walk-in closet, a second newly carpeted bedroom with an adjacent bath, new washer/dryer, new Thermador dishwasher, and San Francisco views that include Mt Sutro. Additional amenities feature deeded parking in a secure garage (with EV charging capability if desired), deeded storage, beautifully landscaped walkways and courtyards, excellent fitness facilities, and a rooftop deck offering more stunning views. Built in 2007, The Potrero is a superbly maintained and secure 165-unit courtyard complex conveniently located directly above Whole Foods, next to a recently redesigned 17th St bike lane, and countless exceptional dining options. This area of Potrero Hill is quickly becoming a magnet for AI companies and new businesses. Enjoy easy commute access to Mission Bay/Dogpatch/downtown, Caltrain, highways, and waterfront attractions.
